links.outcome: Readability (FKGL) of ChatGPT-simplified abstracts versus originals, and lay/physician ratings
links.effect: Readability improved from college graduate level to 8th-9th grade level (p<0.001) despite a 5th-grade target; word and character counts fell (p<0.0001); some patients worried about oversimplification and missing details.
links.quote: The simplification significantly reduced word and character counts (p<0.0001) and improved readability from a college graduate level to an 8th-9th grade level (p<0.001).

links.effect: Improved from college graduate level to 8th-9th grade level (p<0.001), but not the requested 5th-grade level.
